In detail

Dunes, parkland or business park rather than a neighbourhood: CBS records only 160 residents in the whole wijk. There is nothing here to assess and nobody stays in it. It appears because it is one of the city's official wijken, and saying that is more honest than issuing a safety verdict on empty ground.
